T.topic_fa: وقتی برند آن‌قدر یک‌دست می‌شود که محصول گم می‌شود
T.topic_en: When your brand gets so consistent your products disappear
T.central_tension_fa: یک‌دستی برند را از دور قابل شناختن می‌کند؛ ولی اگر همه‌ی محصول‌ها یک شکل شوند، مشتری برند را پیدا می‌کند و محصولش را نه. برند باید شناخته شود، محصول باید پیدا شود.
T.central_tension_en: Consistency makes the brand recognisable from across the aisle. Push it too far and people find your brand but grab the wrong product. The brand should be recognised; the product should be found.
T.working_hook_fa: دو قوطی قرمز. یکی بدون قند. حدس بزن کدام؟
T.working_hook_en: Two red cans. One has zero sugar. You have one second.

key_sources.claim: One global visual system across 200+ markets; 'recognizable at a glance'; Rapha Abreu: 'with one seamless visual identity, we can deliver one recognizable brand experience'. Zero Sugar cues: larger 'Zero Sugar' text, black ribbon on cans, black cap on PET.
Three months on, Original and Zero Sugar are hard to tell apart at a glance; the black-and-red system that set Zero apart is gone (Zero: black can 2005, red can with black logo 2016).
A flight attendant's TikTok: 'Lost count of how many wrong Cokes I've handed out this week'; the Zero cues sit on one side of the can. Anecdotal; do not name or show her.
Experts split: praise for a tighter family; concerns the two look 'extremely similar' and that uniform red 'becomes an accessibility issue'.
2011 white holiday cans were confused with silver Diet Coke; within weeks only a red version was shipping (Coca-Cola did not officially cite confusion).

T.framing_note: Not a Coca-Cola takedown: the unified system is a smart masterbrand move and most people like the look (vendor survey, n=400 US: 74% appealing). The lesson is brand architecture: masterbrand cues for recognition, one unmistakable variant cue (colour/shape) for findability, visible from every side, tested at arm's length in one second. Evidence of confusion is anecdotal and social; say 'people report', never 'sales fell' or 'it failed'. Use the 2011 white-can episode as 'same lesson, 15 years earlier', without claiming Coca-Cola admitted the reason. Max one number on screen (200+ markets or 2011). Do not use the Marlboro/'fridge cigarette' joke or Reddit theories. Do not reuse Tropicana/Ehrenberg-Bass (used 2026-10-24). Official rollout list names a region; never name the UAE, Dubai or any emirate. No Coca-Cola logo generated by AI; only real press images, framed and credited ('Image: The Coca-Cola Company, via The Dieline').
